name: Kakurenbo
source:
A historical nampa novel where main character strives to get intimate with local tea-house girl, kunoichi or samurai girl.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-may-2007-draculius.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一部历史题材的搭讪小说，主人公努力与当地茶馆姑娘、女忍者或女武士发展亲密关系。
